Welcome to Top Physio: our Physiotherapy and Safe Exercise Channel. 

Hi, I am Abu Saleh Ambia, a Chartered Physiotherapist and Independent Prescriber in the UK. 

This Physiotherapy channel will benefit you if you're: 

*Challenged by chronic health issues such as, back pain, neck pain, knee pain and so on
*Keen to learn best Physiotherapy treatment and exercises for common injuries 
*Interested in general health and fitness 
*Enthusiast to learn and use movement as Medicine.

You'll receive a new video every week by subscribing and clicking the notifications bell 🔔 
https://youtube.com/c/topphysiouk

Here you'll learn how to improve your health, to stay fit and well. 

Best wishes 
Abu Saleh
 

Disclaimer: Information provided on this channel is not intended to substitute medical advice. Please consult with your own healthcare professional to get a diagnosis and treatment plan for your specific condition.
